open_points.subject: build_budget_view
open_points.text: build_budget_view: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST make each read and write its other notes call for through get_active_budget_version and list_budget_plans of the budgets repository of that transaction, a BudgetRepository, and through list_project_expenses of the expenses repository of that transaction, an ExpenseRepository, and through list_project_progress of the project_tracking repository of that transaction, a ProjectTrackingRepository.
open_points.other_text: build_budget_view: [VALIDATION_ERROR] When the project has no active budget version, or a supplied version_id resolves to no version of this project, MUST raise ScopedNotFoundError after closing the read transaction, because the version_id of BudgetView is a required identity and absence cannot be returned as a view. It MUST NOT raise RegistryBoundaryError, which belongs to the registry boundary and carries a required failure kind, and it MUST NOT fabricate an empty view with zero totals.
open_points.question: Must build_budget_view be allowed to call BudgetRepository.get_budget_version to resolve a supplied version_id, or must the supplied-version behavior be changed so that only the active version can be resolved through get_active_budget_version?
